title: Bright Data Integration Tools
summary: This module provides tools for integrating with Bright Data's services, enabling AI agents to perform web search (SERP) and advanced web scraping (Web Unlocker) by interacting with Bright Data's APIs.

nodes.label: Perform Web Search (SERP)
nodes.title: BrightDataSearchTool
nodes.description: Executes web search queries across various search engines (e.g., Google, Bing) using Bright Data's SERP API. It can retrieve structured search results or raw page content, with options for geotargeting, language, and device type.

nodes.label: Scrape Web Pages (Unlocker)
nodes.title: BrightDataWebUnlockerTool
nodes.description: Performs web scraping using Bright Data's Web Unlocker API. This tool bypasses bot protection, CAPTCHAs, and geo-restrictions to extract content from web pages, returning it in raw or markdown format.

nodes.label: Bright Data SERP API
nodes.title: Bright Data SERP API
nodes.description: External Bright Data service providing search engine results page (SERP) data based on specified queries and parameters.

nodes.label: Bright Data Web Unlocker API
nodes.title: Bright Data Web Unlocker API
nodes.description: External Bright Data service for advanced web scraping, capable of bypassing bot detection, CAPTCHAs, and geo-restrictions to retrieve web content.

nodes.label: Environment Variables
nodes.title: API Credentials
nodes.description: Stores sensitive configuration like Bright Data API keys (BRIGHT_DATA_API_KEY) and zone identifiers (BRIGHT_DATA_ZONE), essential for authenticating with Bright Data services.

groups.label: Agent Tools
groups.title: Agent-Facing Tools
groups.description: These components are the primary interfaces for AI agents to interact with Bright Data services.

groups.label: External Bright Data Services
groups.title: External Bright Data Services
groups.description: External APIs provided by Bright Data for web search and scraping operations.
